data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's claimed separating property conjoins two distinct mechanisms: additive linear operator structure (Rule 90) and conserved monotonic ordering (Rule 184). This is a renamed partition of the observed data, not a separating property. The problem explicitly warns that 'a separating property that is merely renamed data is worth little' and requires a single structural property that separates the pairs that do from the pairs that do not. By listing two unrelated properties (one for each rule family), the target fails to provide the unifying structural criterion demanded. It also fails to apply the criterion to Rule 110 (whose behavior is characterized as 'long chaotic transients' without stating which side of the separation it falls on).
